summary.headline: Ceigall Q1 FY27 standalone revenue rose 10.2% YoY to INR901 crore, with EBITDA margin at 13.4% and order book at INR18,568 crore.
summary.overview: Standalone revenue grew 10.2% YoY to INR901 crore and PAT rose to INR75 crore (8.4% margin) from INR56 crore. Consolidated revenue grew 15.7% to INR970 crore. The company completed its first HAM divestment (Malout-Abohar-Sadhuwali) and started three new projects, while management kept FY27 margin guidance of 11-12.5% and raised revenue growth guidance to at least 15%. Q1 order inflow was modest at about INR600 crore against a INR6,000 crore full-year target.

segments.name: Order book mix
segments.commentary: 19 EPC projects, 10 HAM projects, 1 DBFOT project and 9 tariff-based renewable and transmission projects. Diversification extends to metro rail, renewable energy, T&D and industrial infrastructure.

segments.name: Renewable energy (Solar plus BESS)
segments.commentary: Signed a PPA for a Solar BESS at Morena and emerged L1 for a standalone battery storage project. Maharashtra solar projects MH1 and MH2 started in Q1. Rewa solar awaits a transmission line tender before start.

segments.name: HAM and highways
segments.commentary: Divested Malout-Abohar-Sadhuwali, the first HAM asset monetised. Signed concession for Ambala-Chandigarh-Zirakpur HAM. Received appointed dates for VRK 11, VRK 12 and Indore-Ujjain HAM after quarter end. Northern Ayodhya bypass execution was about INR42 crore in Q1.

guidance_outlook: EBITDA margin guidance of 11% to 12.5% for FY27 maintained, per CFO.
Revenue growth guidance raised to minimum 15% for FY27, from earlier 10-15%.
Order inflow target of about INR6,000 crore for FY27; close to INR600 crore secured so far. Order inflow typically concentrated in Q3 and Q4 (about 45% of the order book came in Q4 last year).
Full-year capex guidance of INR30-35 crore.
Balance equity commitment of INR859 crore in FY27 (INR310 crore solar, INR550 crore HAM) and INR744 crore in FY28 (INR296 crore solar, INR444 crore HAM).
Execution targets: VRK 11 and VRK 12 at least 20-25% in FY27; Southern Ludhiana at least 15% due to only 62% land availability.
Working capital intensity expected to improve in FY27 and further in FY28, citing government relaxation.
Commercial paper of about INR100 crore on private placement, carved out of working capital limits at about 6.8-7% versus WCDL at 7.5-7.8%.
capex_capacity: Q1 capex about INR14 crore, mainly a launcher bought at Danapur; more than INR100 crore of machinery already paid from IPO proceeds.
Full-year FY27 capex guidance INR30-35 crore; specialised machinery to be bought only as required.
Three new projects started in Q1 (MH1, MH2 solar and Indore-Ujjain HAM); three more to start from July after appointed dates.
Two HAM projects (Bihar and Punjab) await appointed dates: Bihar FC expected next month, Punjab around November; work to start 2-3 months after FC.

Equity infusion by project for FY27 includes VRK 11 INR97 crore, VRK 12 INR139 crore, Northern Ayodhya INR61 crore, Southern Ayodhya INR53 crore, Ludhiana-Bhatinda INR53 crore, Southern Ludhiana INR38 crore, Indore-Ujjain INR60 crore, Bihar Sahebganj INR50 crore and Zirakpur INR16 crore.
demand_pricing: Management cited a Q1 seasonal slowdown from monsoon; order inflow was modest in Q1 with the bulk expected in Q3 and Q4.
International: bids in Romania and Dubai; management is taking a conservative approach given the war situation, with focus on India.
Management says the company targets 25% project-level IRR and will sell completed projects, citing Malout-Abohar-Sadhuwali returns above guidance.
Renewable margins guided in line with EPC margins, with an aim to do better.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Northern Ayodhya bypass execution fall to about INR42 crore in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said progress is steady and milestones are being met early; payment is only received on milestone achievement, and rain over the last 1.5 months affected timing.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Rewa solar project timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: PPA and land are in place; the transmission line tender has been floated and the company expects it soon, after which the project can start quickly.

qa_highlights.question: What equity will be invested in HAM and solar in FY27 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 balance commitment INR859 crore (INR310 crore solar, INR550 crore HAM); FY28 INR744 crore (INR296 crore solar, INR444 crore HAM). Initial equity at IPO was INR253 crore; total now INR692 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Why was margin higher than guidance and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Three new projects started in Q1 and more are starting; the CFO said FY27 margin guidance of 11-12.5% is maintained.

qa_highlights.question: Why did depreciation and other income fall sharply?
qa_highlights.answer: Depreciation fell due to assets sold in the prior year on WDV method; other income fell as royalty is no longer charged and IPO-linked FD interest ended. About INR320 crore in FDs now earn interest, and management expects this run rate to continue.

qa_highlights.question: What is the purpose of the commercial paper issuance?
qa_highlights.answer: CP of about INR100 crore is carved out of working capital limits, at about 6.8-7% versus WCDL at 7.5-7.8%, to reduce finance cost and access the market.

risks_watch: Execution slippage risk: Southern Ludhiana limited to at least 15% in FY27 due to only 62% land availability; Northern Ayodhya bypass billing fell to about INR42 crore in Q1, attributed to rain and milestone-linked payments.

Equity deployment: INR859 crore FY27 and INR744 crore FY28 balance commitments; management said HAM equity of INR550 crore is incremental and will be infused project by project as progress is achieved.
Appointed dates pending: Bihar HAM FC expected next month and Punjab HAM around November; work starts 2-3 months after FC, so FY27 execution depends on these timelines.
Order inflow back-loaded: about INR600 crore secured against INR6,000 crore FY27 target, with management expecting the bulk in Q3 and Q4 (about 45% of order book came in Q4 last year).
Rewa solar start depends on a transmission line tender that management said had been floated but not yet awarded.

Margin sustainability: Q1 standalone EBITDA margin of 13.4% is above the 11-12.5% FY27 guidance; management attributed it to three new project starts and maintained guidance without quantifying one-offs.

Other income and depreciation run-rate: other income of INR9.5 crore reflects about INR320 crore of FDs now that IPO proceeds are used up; depreciation of INR9.5 crore reflects WDV method after prior-year asset sales.

summary.management_tone: Management was confident on execution, margins and capital recycling, citing the Malout-Abohar-Sadhuwali divestment and early milestone achievement. It was cautious on international expansion, citing the war situation, and on Southern Ludhiana land availability, and it was evasive on the Northern Ayodhya billing dip and on the HAM equity split, where answers were given in fragments and the CFO clarified figures under questioning.

growth.why: Management raised FY27 revenue growth floor to a minimum 15% and Q1 consolidated revenue grew 15.7% with an INR18,568 crore order book and several projects starting, but Q1 order inflow of about INR600 crore against a INR6,000 crore FY27 target is well behind pace and the bulk is back-ended to Q3-Q4.
